'''Luminastra''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Glimmerwing]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Guardian of the long night, who paints galaxies of brilliant stardust that outshine the sun. Though, if your party is in need of specialized lighting for the right vibes, Luminastra can also be persuaded to serve as the most overqualified Tatari disco ball."

Luminastra is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

* Luminastra and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/1/2026 alongside [[Umbraveil]] and [[Hierotyrus]].
